fields.Name: T146 - MCP Log Detail Slide-In Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the log-detail slide-in panel (onLogClick → ShowLogDetailPanel) with its accordion sections — a bespoke right-side detail drawer, not the generic record preview panel or entity form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT Ctrl+K), open the MCP section, then go to the Logs tab. The Logs tab shows an execution-logs table (Status, Server, Tool, Connection, Started, Duration, Error). Click a log row and confirm a detail panel slides in from the right showing the tool name, status/timing, connection info, and collapsible sections for Input Arguments / Result / Error. Success is that clicking a log row opens the slide-in detail panel; if there are no logs, a valid 'No recent execution logs' empty state is acceptable and no panel is expected. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Logs tab shows an execution-log table with columns, OR a valid 'No recent execution logs' empty state
Clicking a log row opens a right-side slide-in detail panel with the tool name, status, and connection details (when at least one log exists)
The detail panel shows collapsible sections (e.g. Input Arguments / Result / Error) and can be closed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
